obligation: Whole-sector source construction and contact compatibility before wrapped readout
source: buildPESymmetricSector(3), unchanged makeLatticeItem subdivision, unchanged createWindowConstruction PNE protocol
enumeration: Every whole regular tetrahedral seed in the sector, both orientations, all 24 bijective assignments of C0/M0/C1/M1. Execute actual PN and NE steps. Classify failed, outside-occupied-support, outside-reference-context, and fully internal packets separately. Never identify independent packet histories.
candidate_global_family_field: C iff (q0+q2) mod 2 is odd; M otherwise. This retains the canonical unit seed markings and is a proposed spatial family field only, not a source-derived absolute phase index.
family_field_tests: Every native regular and subdivided-octahedral primitive has exactly two C and two M vertices. Test which actual packets preserve this family field. Independently propagate the MMCC constraints from only the canonical seed; retain each inference, never infer unconstrained values.
full_occupancy_hostile: For a marked regular P carrier, all four neighboring primitive faces occupied. Allowed direct P contacts are PN and require two M vertices on the shared face. Enumerate all 24 seed markings; an MMCC tetrahedron has only two such faces. P-E/P-P contacts cannot repair the other two under the current alphabet.
coverage: Report both whole-host coverage and coverage of every native primitive. A touched host is not fully covered unless all its subdivision components occur. Atlas coverage is not simultaneous occupancy, equal origins, path independence or a global coefficient section.

reader_graph_continuation.introduced_after: Initial18-check packet-atlas enumeration, retained as packet-atlas-verification.json
reader_graph_continuation.operations: Add actual P/N reader and NN phase-advance witnesses between compatible packet charts; retain PN, inverse-PN and NE. NN target must be the source packet's actual next E geometry, read as N by a separate native packet chart.
reader_graph_continuation.identification: Shared geometric vertex names are used only within explicit native phase-advance witnesses; packet/chart identity and path history are never merged.
reader_graph_continuation.reachability: Finite base-graph reachability from the exact canonical marked root. Each representative path is lifted with its absolute origin, coefficient permutation and persistent parent/edge history. Other paths are represented by the retained edge graph, not declared identical.
hostiles: reader edge that violates a native witness
jump to a non-native NN target
infer simultaneous occupation from reference-path reachability

symmetry_and_orbit_continuation.operation: Test the existing geometric D(q)=2c-q on the entire packet atlas and native edge graph, keeping physical species, ordered coefficient slots, absolute origin and transported command histories. This is a candidate reference-frame symmetry, not a new native advance command or physical charge conjugation.
symmetry_and_orbit_continuation.invariant: For family-compatible packets test whether all three M references share h=q0+q2 and whether every native edge preserves h. Test D sends h to2-h without assuming D is reachable as a native path.
symmetry_and_orbit_continuation.hostile: Reject merging disconnected native-operation components merely because a geometric symmetry exchanges them.

scope: No invented phase transitions, forced Pb counts, particle assignment from geometric P/N/E labels, or viewer changes. A failure applies to the frozen source alphabet, subdivision and candidate conditions, not every possible global construction.
